baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated accountability verb contrasts "باللغو" with "بما عقدتم الأيمان".
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech enters liability only when it is intentionally tied into a durable oath-bond. Laghw is thrown out of the account, while عقد makes the oath something graspable as a commitment.

activation_trace.role: Accountability for what issued from a person supplies the legal grasp applied on both sides of the contrast.
The image of something discarded and not counted supplies the no-liability threshold.
Binding and ratifying an undertaking makes deliberate oath-speech an enforceable bond.
The oath and sworn undertaking image identifies the repeated object being formed, repaired, and guarded.

changed_reading.before: All oath-like speech appears to create one undifferentiated liability.
changed_reading.after: Only speech deliberately consolidated into an oath-bond enters accountability; uncounted verbal overflow does not.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath-knot is followed by expiation through feeding, clothing, freeing a neck, or, when means fail, fasting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The remedy does not privately cancel the bond. It converts a verbal liability into outward provision measured by ordinary household care, or into human release; lack of means converts it into embodied restraint.

activation_trace.role: Tying endpoints supplies the binding condition that the remedy must answer.
Covering the wrong until its operative trace is removed supplies the reparative function of expiation.
Feeding another, especially one in need, turns private speech-liability into transferred sustenance.
A middle rank between high and low calibrates the transfer to an ordinary domestic standard.
The household circle supplies the familiar care-standard exported to people outside it.
Freedom opposed to bondage makes release a direct counter-movement to the oath's binding.
Means and material sufficiency gate the outward options without erasing responsibility.
Fasting as restraint relocates repair into the body when outward means are unavailable.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists interchangeable penalties for a broken oath.
changed_reading.after: It designs a capacity-sensitive de-binding process that translates speech into measured care, liberation, or self-restraint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated أيمان is finally governed by "واحفظوا أيمانكم".
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath sense remains primary, but the right-hand, force, and custody branches overlay it with agency. What is guarded is not only each promise's duration but the human capacity to bind oneself and others through authorized speech.

activation_trace.role: The right hand and rightward side give the oath an embodied image of exercised agency.
Power, capacity, and the side of right make oath-keeping stewardship of consequential speech.
Guarding and tending an entrusted thing supplies ongoing custody rather than a single act of compliance.
Covenant and persistent alliance extend the oath from utterance into a maintained relation.

changed_reading.before: "Guard your oaths" means only never to break a sworn statement.
changed_reading.after: It also calls for custody of the power by which binding commitments are made, including disciplined repair when that power is mishandled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding prohibition on forbidding good things and the branch image of untying a knot recast expiation as a lawful release valve: a human oath-knot must not harden into a rival prohibition on what God has opened.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the tied knot whose force needs lawful management.
Prohibition as active prevention supplies the danger of turning voluntary speech into a self-made ban.
The image of untying a knot directly reverses the focus's image of binding one.
Expiatory covering supplies the authorized transition out of the self-made bond.

structural_cues: 5:87 says not to prohibit the good things God made lawful, and 5:88 commands eating lawful good provision immediately before the oath rule.
The focus offers food-related repair rather than allowing a verbal restriction to become permanent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and the عقد knot versus حل untying images; I infer an arrow from self-binding over lawful goods to authorized release. A live alternative is that 5:87-88 and 5:89 regulate adjacent but independent conduct.

changed_reading.before: Expiation is simply a payment after violating any vow.
changed_reading.after: It can function as a boundary-preserving release that prevents deliberate human vows from manufacturing permanent prohibitions while retaining accountability for deliberate speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed quantity, household midpoint, and needy recipients of oath repair contrast with gambling's chance allocation and its production of rivalry. The remedy redirects value through a predictable, relational measure rather than adversarial gain.

activation_trace.role: A middle rank supplies a stable measure instead of volatile or maximal extraction.
Feeding the needy directs the cost toward sustenance rather than reciprocal contest.
Gambling and division by lots supply the nearby rival mechanism of uncertain value transfer.
Enmity supplies the social output of the rival mechanism that measured repair avoids.

structural_cues: The gambling prohibition follows the oath rule immediately.
5:91 explicitly links gambling to enmity, hatred, and blockage of remembrance and prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured support transfer in 5:89 and chance allocation producing hostility in 5:90-91; I infer that the former repairs social relations by opposing the latter's mechanics. The alternative is that their adjacency is thematic rather than contrastive.

changed_reading.before: The ten-person household-standard remedy is an arbitrary tariff.
changed_reading.after: It is a measured, non-chance conversion of private liability into sustenance, with a social form opposite to rivalrous extraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hunting rule reuses expiation, feeding the poor, and fasting, while adding deliberateness, equivalence, pardon of what has passed, and a boundary at repetition. This exposes a portable repair calculus: intent activates liability, proportional outward action answers it, capacity selects the mode, and return changes the status.

activation_trace.role: The uncounted image supplies the focus's lower intent threshold.
A settled heart or resolve supplies the focus's positive intent threshold.
Deliberate aim confirms that the parallel liability also turns on intention.
Equivalence and balancing supply proportional calibration to the parallel repair.
The same expiatory covering marks the hunting response as a second instance of the repair architecture.
Feeding others repeats outward sustenance as a reparative channel.
Materially constrained recipients repeat the social destination of repair.
Fasting repeats embodied restraint as the convertible alternative.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault supplies the treatment of what preceded the rule.
Return after departure supplies the repeat-offense boundary beyond ordinary repair.

structural_cues: 5:95 exactly repeats the sequence expiation, food for poor people, or fasting.
The parallel rule adds deliberate action, judged equivalence, pardon of the past, and a consequence for returning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated remedy template and its added modifiers; I infer a shared legal architecture across oath and hunting violations. The live alternative is that equivalence, adjudication, and recurrence are domain-specific additions rather than general features of oath expiation.

changed_reading.before: 5:89 contains a one-off menu peculiar to oath breach.
changed_reading.after: Its menu is one realization of a broader intent-sensitive, proportional, capacity-aware repair calculus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby opposition between what is made manifest and what is concealed separates expiatory covering from secrecy. Kaffara covers the operative trace of fault by an outward repair, while the verse's closing clarification keeps the truth legible.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the potentially ambiguous image that context must distinguish from hiding.
Manifestation and disclosure keep the repaired matter intelligible rather than suppressed.
Emergence into view supplies one pole of the explicit disclose-conceal contrast.
Hiding and covering up supply the rejected alternative to reparative covering.

structural_cues: The focus's remedies are observable acts of feeding, clothing, release, or fasting.
5:99 pairs what people disclose with what they conceal, and 5:106 later calls concealment of testimony sinful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two different covering mechanisms, one reparative and one concealing; I infer that visible performance distinguishes them. The alternative is that the disclose-conceal pair addresses divine knowledge without commenting on expiation.

changed_reading.before: Expiation covers a fault by making it disappear from view.
changed_reading.after: It covers liability through inspectable repair, not through suppressing the breach or its truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witness procedure uses sworn speech as public evidence and permits later oaths to displace earlier ones when wrongdoing is discovered. Guarding oaths therefore protects evidentiary reliability, not the immutability of every sworn claim.

activation_trace.role: The sworn undertaking supplies the focus object later deployed in a public procedure.
Preserving covenant and protected trust becomes custody of the oath's public reliability.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign links guarded oaths to truthful evidence.
Testimony as knowledgeable declaration supplies the public truth-task assigned to sworn speech.
An oath formally apportioned to its bearers supplies the procedural act used to secure testimony.
Rejecting what proves false supplies correction rather than blind preservation of prior sworn claims.
The explicit sequence of oaths after earlier oaths shows that sworn evidence can be procedurally superseded.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 moves from witnesses swearing, through discovery of culpability, to replacement witnesses and oaths after prior oaths.
The stated aim is testimony delivered "on its face," with fear that prior oaths may be returned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath-backed testimony and a correction mechanism; I infer that preserving oaths means preserving their truth-bearing institution. A live alternative is that the witness procedure is a special forensic use with no broader effect on 5:89.

changed_reading.before: Guarding oaths preserves a private bond at all costs.
changed_reading.after: It preserves the credibility of binding speech, which includes exposing false use and allowing truth-governed procedural reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table sequence links eating with heart-assurance, verified truth, witness, sign, and provision. By analogy, feeding in expiation can make repaired credibility materially perceptible: provision becomes a social sign that a failed word has been answered.

activation_trace.role: Feeding others supplies the material act whose meaning context expands beyond transfer of calories.
A manifest sign connects the repaired act to the focus's closing disclosure.
Recognizing and displaying benefit supplies the intended response to the repaired provision.
A table bearing food supplies the concrete setting in which eating becomes evidence.
Stillness and assurance supply the inward effect sought through shared eating.
Fulfilled word and verified deed make food a test of whether speech has become true in action.
The table explicitly becomes a visible sign, linking provision to intelligible confirmation.
Apportioned gift and provision supply the table's outward beneficence.

structural_cues: 5:112-114 moves in sequence from a requested table, to eating and heart-assurance, to truth, witness, sign, and provision.
The focus itself moves from feeding to clarified signs and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the food-to-assurance-to-truth-to-sign sequence; I infer an analogical arrow from expiatory feeding to restored credibility. The materially live alternative is that the miraculous table confirms revelation and does not characterize ordinary expiatory meals.

changed_reading.before: Feeding is merely the monetary equivalent of an oath penalty.
changed_reading.after: Feeding can also be a credibility-restoring sign: a word's repair becomes tangible as provision received by others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing judgment says that truth itself benefits the truthful, then locates all dominion with God. This extends guarded oath-speech across time: expiation repairs failure, but the enduring value being protected is truthful speech under final ownership and audit.

activation_trace.role: The oath as a sworn undertaking supplies the form of truth-bearing speech under custody.
Persistent maintenance carries the oath's truth-value beyond the instant of utterance.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the final yield assigned to truth.
Truthful saying names the durable quality that ultimately proves beneficial.
Ultimate sovereignty places every human act of binding speech beneath God's final jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 5:119 explicitly makes the truth of truthful people beneficial on the final day.
5:120 closes the packet with God's sovereignty over everything.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies final benefit for truth and universal divine sovereignty; I infer that oath-custody preserves speech for that terminal audit. The alternative is that 5:119 concerns truth generally without a special return to oaths.

changed_reading.before: Oath repair settles a short-term private breach.
changed_reading.after: It restores a person's speech to a truth-bearing economy whose value persists to final judgment under divine sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads one remedy as materially enacting a root image of the remedy's name. It remains anchored in the focus's كفارة and كسوتهم, but should be rendered only as a lexical-material echo, not as etymological proof or a claim that clothing is the privileged option.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covering image in كفارة stands beside the option of literally clothing the recipients.

activation_trace.role: Covering and overlaying supply the abstract image of expiation.
Garment and clothing perform the covering image as a concrete benefit to another person.

changed_reading.before: Clothing is simply one fungible item in the remedy list.
changed_reading.after: Clothing may also stage the semantic image of expiation: moral covering becomes a literal, beneficial covering of another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reversal from verbal bond to human bondage. It remains validly anchored in عقدتم and تحرير رقبة and is sharpened by the packet's later servant and dominion language; downstream prose should call it an anti-isomorphic structural analogy, not an exclusive rationale or an equation of oath and enslavement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A self-made oath-knot can be answered by the option that frees a human neck.

activation_trace.role: Tying endpoints supplies the bond created by deliberate speech.
Freedom opposed to slavery supplies the exact counter-movement to binding.
The human neck supplies the person whose imposed bond is removed.
Servitude as ownership sharpens the human bond reversed by liberation.
Possession and disposal locate human release within the packet's closing claim about true ownership.

changed_reading.before: Freeing a neck is merely a high-value substitute in a penalty schedule.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as a deliberate counter-bond: repair for self-binding speech takes the form of removing an imposed bond from another human.

strongest_changes: The 5:87-89 sequence and the عقد versus حل branch reversal recast expiation as an authorized release from self-made prohibition.
The exact remedy recurrence in 5:95 exposes an intent-sensitive, proportional, capacity-aware repair architecture.
The oath-backed witness procedure in 5:106-108 turns guarding oaths into protection of public evidentiary reliability.
The table sequence in 5:112-114 makes feeding legible as a possible material sign of restored credibility.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly moved the focus from private vow management into boundary calibration, restorative provision, public evidence, and durable truth. The strongest activation was the collision between the focus's oath-knot and the preceding root image of lawful untying.
remaining_uncertainties: The adjacency of 5:87-88 may frame oath-driven self-denial specifically, or it may only place independent rules beside one another.
The table-sign analogy is productive but may not define ordinary expiatory feeding.
The right-hand capacity overlay and the covering-clothing echo should remain qualified branch activations rather than lexical disambiguations.
